0.content:
# z/VM fleet

Fleet status from OTLP metrics. The system variable lists hosts. The LPAR variable lists LPARs on those hosts. Host tiles keep a host only when zvm.system.info matches both. Exporter up has no host attribute, so that tile is not filtered.

1.title: CPU by system
1.description: Average INDICATE LOAD utilization for the selected system and LPAR. High CPU plus high steal means the LPAR is busy.

2.title: Exporter up
2.description: 1 when the last Feilong host scrape worked. 0 means Feilong failed while the process was still exporting. zvm.exporter.up has no host attribute, so this tile is not split by host or LPAR. A missing series is the separate missing-data event.

3.title: Paging utilization
3.description: Paging pages in use over pages allocated for the selected system and LPAR. Trend, not an outage signal.

4.title: Spool utilization
4.description: Spool pages in use over pages allocated for the selected system and LPAR.
